description: This file defines a Lightning component named 'NotesList' that provides a UI for displaying, searching, creating, and navigating notes. It imports external services and libraries, manages internal state related to note items, and offers methods for user interactions such as filtering, focusing, and creating notes.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: A Lightning component for listing notes with search and navigation functionalities.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refetches all notes and applies current filter.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters notes based on search query.

methods.name: ensureOnSelect
methods.description: Ensures the currently focused note is selected by invoking the onSelect callback.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query and filters notes accordingly.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new note with default title and selects it.

methods.name: focusNext
methods.description: Moves focus to the next note in the list.

methods.name: focusPrev
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous note in the list.

methods.name: $rowColor
methods.description: Determines the background color of a row based on selection.

methods.name: $rowAlpha
methods.description: Determines the transparency of a row based on selection.

methods.name: $time
methods.description: Formats ISO timestamp to a human-readable string.
